fix.summary: Read the MIG manager's log for the node (`kubectl -n gpu-operator logs -l app=nvidia-mig-manager --field-selector spec.nodeName=<node>` on the pod there) and its events; fix the profile in your mig-parted config, or set nvidia.com/mig.config back to a config the GPUs support.

title: 2 Jobs request accelerators with no queue: no fair share or preemption
evidence: kueue: CRDs installed but no controller runs

fix.summary: Install Kueue as the stack's queue (forge.Install, pinned; delivery "bootstrap" because it ships CRDs, so apply it with `forge env deploy <env> --target kueue`), then give each team a LocalQueue and label jobs with kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name. The diff also installs JobSet (`--target jobset`), Kueue's unit for multi-pod training.

title: 1 inference server scales on the wrong signal
evidence: Deployment/serving/chat (vllm): no HorizontalPodAutoscaler or KEDA ScaledObject

fix.summary: Scale on queue depth, not CPU: a KEDA ScaledObject with a Prometheus trigger on vllm:num_requests_waiting (or KV-cache usage; Triton: nv_inference_queue_duration_us).

title: 2 accelerator nodes have no node health detection: bad nodes keep getting work
evidence: no node-problem-detector, no EKS node monitoring agent, and no node condition a health source sets

fix.summary: Otherwise install node-problem-detector as the stack's node_health, with a kernel-log rule that sets GPUProblem on a fatal NVIDIA Xid.

title: Accelerator images fan out to many nodes with no peer-to-peer pull cache

fix.summary: Install Spegel as the stack's pull_cache (one small DaemonSet: nodes pull layers from each other instead of the registry). It needs containerd's registry config_path and discard_unpacked_layers=false; check its compatibility notes for your node image first.

title: 1 workload runs accelerators with the 64 MiB /dev/shm default
evidence: Job/serving/bench: 1 pod, container bench mounts no memory emptyDir at /dev/shm

fix.summary: Mount an emptyDir {medium: Memory} (with a sizeLimit) at /dev/shm in each accelerator container: NCCL, PyTorch DataLoader workers and vLLM's tensor parallelism need more than 64 MiB.

title: 1 container downloads from Hugging Face without the fast path
evidence: Deployment/serving/chat: vllm downloads Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct from the Hugging Face Hub with neither HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE nor HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER set

fix.summary: Set HF_XET_HIGH_PERFORMANCE=1 (huggingface_hub with hf_xet; HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER is deprecated), or better, stop downloading per pod.

vLLM: pass --otlp-traces-endpoint <collector>:4317 (and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME). Triton: --trace-config mode=opentelemetry --trace-config opentelemetry,url=<collector>:4318/v1/traces. Per-request spans show queueing, prefill and decode time.

title: No continuous profiling on the accelerator nodes

fix.summary: Run one continuous eBPF profiler as a DaemonSet on the accelerator nodes: Parca agent, Grafana Alloy with pyroscope.ebpf, or the OpenTelemetry eBPF profiler (otel/opentelemetry-collector-ebpf-profiler). It shows where CPU time goes in data loaders and serving code with no code change.
Install an OpenTelemetry Collector with an otlp receiver (grpc :4317, http :4318) so vLLM, Triton and training jobs can export traces and metrics.

title: Image volumes are unavailable: weights cannot be mounted from an OCI artifact without a sidecar
evidence: API server v1.33.1+k3s1: the ImageVolume feature gate is on by default from Kubernetes 1.35

fix.summary: Upgrade to Kubernetes 1.35+ with containerd 2.1+ to mount weights as an image volume. Until then, KServe's modelcar sidecar or an init-container copy is the fallback.

title: Kubelet tracing may be off on 2 self-managed accelerator nodes (unverified)
evidence: kube-system/kubelet-config was not read (not a kubeadm cluster, or the grant refused it); the kubelet's config file lives on each node, which discovery never reads

fix.summary: Discovery cannot read the kubelet's config (it never requests nodes/proxy), so check it: if KubeletConfiguration has no `tracing` block, add one (GA in Kubernetes 1.34) pointing at your OTLP collector, to see image pull and container start spans. Dismiss this finding once it is on.

title: 1 accelerator Job exports no OTLP traces

fix.summary: Set OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT (and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME) on the Job's containers, or inject an SDK with an OpenTelemetry Instrumentation resource, so steps and data-loading spans reach your collector.
